description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git p4 preserve users' functionality. It includes setup for a Perforce server, creating files, managing users, and validating that user preservation during git to p4 commits works correctly, including handling of permissions and unknown users.

methods.name: p4_grant_admin
methods.description: Grants admin permissions to a specified user in Perforce.

methods.name: p4_check_commit_author
methods.description: Checks if the latest change for a given file was committed by the specified user.

methods.name: make_change_by_user
methods.description: Creates a file change attributed to a specific user and commits it in the git repository.
